info.name: SCRUM-204 Onboarding: working pipeline
info.description:
Success path only of the onboarding page and Keycloak role grants (docs/onboarding-role-grants.md); the error cases are in SCRUM-204-onboarding-role-grants.postman_collection.json. Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner: every token is fetched by the collection itself, including the new token after each grant.

Before running:
- the service runs with KEYCLOAK_ROLE_ADMIN_ENABLED=true and KEYCLOAK_ROLE_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET set (client geozentra-role-admin), and ONBOARDING_SELF_SERVICE_ROLES empty (the default: the admin approves investor and lender requests, like realtor licenses);
- five Keycloak accounts with a password and no pending required action: an admin (realm role admin) and four FRESH accounts that never answered the onboarding page and have no professional role: home buyer, investor, lender, realtor. An account keeps its role, so each run needs four new accounts.

Usernames and passwords are left empty: set them in your local environment and never commit them.

Folders: 0 admin login; 1 home buyer; 2 investor and 3 lender (request, admin approval); 4 realtor (license approved by the admin, then listed in the realtor directory); 5 the admin changes the investor account to lender (revoke, the user requests lender, the admin approves).

exec: pm.test('fresh account: onboarding page not answered yet', () => pm.expect(r.onboardingCompleted).to.eql(false));
pm.test('no professional role in the token', () => pm.expect(professional(tokenRoles)).to.eql([]));
pm.test('fresh account: onboarding page not answered yet', () => pm.expect(r.onboardingCompleted).to.eql(false));
pm.test('PENDING: waits for the admin (APPROVED instead means the role is listed in ONBOARDING_SELF_SERVICE_ROLES)', () => pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('PENDING'));
pm.test('request listed for the applicant', () => { pm.expect(it).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(it.userId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('investorUserId'))); });

pm.test('APPROVED by the admin (503 instead means role management is off)', () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('APPROVED'); pm.expect(r.decidedByUserId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('adminUserId'))); });

// a new license number on every run

item.name: Admin: license in the review queue

exec: pm.test('submission listed for the applicant', () => { pm.expect(it).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(it.applicantUserId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('realtorUserId'))); });
pm.test('VERIFIED (503 instead means role management is off)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('VERIFIED'));

item.name: Log in again (new token with the role)
Home buyer sees the realtor in the directory
Admin: grant history of the realtor

exec: pm.test('realtor granted from the license', () => { pm.expect(latest.role).to.eql('realtor'); pm.expect(latest.action).to.eql('GRANT'); pm.expect(latest.source).to.eql('REALTOR_LICENSE'); });

item.name: 5. Admin changes the investor account to lender

exec: pm.test('investor granted on the approved request', () => { pm.expect(latest.role).to.eql('investor'); pm.expect(latest.action).to.eql('GRANT'); pm.expect(latest.source).to.eql('ROLE_REQUEST'); });
pm.test('no professional role in the token', () => pm.expect(professional(tokenRoles)).to.eql([]));
pm.test('PENDING: waits for the admin (APPROVED instead means the role is listed in ONBOARDING_SELF_SERVICE_ROLES)', () => pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('PENDING'));
pm.test('request listed for the applicant', () => { pm.expect(it).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(it.userId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('investorUserId'))); });

pm.test('APPROVED by the admin (503 instead means role management is off)', () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('APPROVED'); pm.expect(r.decidedByUserId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('adminUserId'))); });

item.name: Log in again (new token with lender)

exec: const steps = pm.response.json().slice(0, 3).map(e => e.role + ' ' + e.action + ' ' + e.source);
pm.test('grant, revoke, grant (newest first)', () => pm.expect(steps).to.eql(['lender GRANT ROLE_REQUEST', 'investor REVOKE ADMIN_REVOCATION', 'investor GRANT ROLE_REQUEST']));
